A photorealistic live-action educational video in one uninterrupted continuous take. The woman exactly matches the reference image, preserving the same facial identity, facial proportions, eye shape, hairstyle, overall hair silhouette, clothing, skin tone, desk, background, colors, and lighting throughout the entire video.

A completely locked eye-level camera captures a stable frontal upper-body medium shot. She sits upright but relaxed behind the desk, with her head facing directly forward and her chin remaining level.

She maintains uninterrupted direct eye contact with the exact center of the camera lens from the first frame to the last frame. Both eyes remain naturally aligned toward the lens, with a steady forward gaze and stable head direction while speaking and during every pause.

She gives a calm, friendly, and professional educational explanation with a subtle natural smile, gentle breathing, occasional natural blinking, and minimal upper-body movement. Only her lips, jaw, and subtle facial muscles move while speaking. Her mouth movement is restrained, natural, and precisely synchronized to the provided audio.

Both hands rest calmly and visibly on the desktop throughout the entire video. The hands remain below chest level, away from the face, and mostly still. Each hand maintains realistic anatomy, stable proportions, matching skin tone, and exactly five naturally formed fingers.

During speech pauses, she continues looking directly into the camera lens. Her head, gaze, pose, hands, identity, framing, and background remain unchanged. Her lips close naturally while only subtle breathing and occasional blinking continue.

Her hair appears naturally soft, light, airy, and slightly voluminous, with a gentle fluffy texture and subtle separation between individual strands. The hairstyle maintains its original shape, length, and overall silhouette. Only a few fine strands along the outer edges show barely perceptible natural micro-movement, while the main body of the hair remains stable and softly settled. Her face remains fully visible and unobstructed.

Soft frontal indoor lighting, realistic skin texture, clear natural eyes, stable facial and hand anatomy, naturally soft and slightly voluminous hair, barely perceptible hair-strand movement, smooth restrained motion, strong temporal consistency, and consistent composition throughout the entire video.
